acceptance: Each registered assertion must pass; failures/denials and deliberate unsafe diagnostic effects remain outcomes. This is instrument acceptance, not deployment or population C/R/E acceptance.
cost: Count actual local signature checks/hash reads/policy operations; record local elapsed time separately. No tariffs, salaries or production SLA inferred.

coverage.correspondence: declared local realization, no operational isomorphism proved
coverage.M: explicitly allowed lower-value outcome only when chosen/completed
coverage.incomplete: no sufficient route within the registered horizon
coverage.probability_law: designed finite cases; no population probability fitted
coverage.business_value: illustrative process objective; owner calibration pending

private_state: Expected flags and actual-world facts belong only to the evaluator; participant functions receive observations/claims and admitted current policy sources.
credential_policy: Ephemeral fixture signing keys and compact tokens remain in memory; no credential or private key in output.
implementation_profile: RATS-informed local software-state produce/appraise/consume profile with generic JWS

cases.narrative: Current software evidence meets the selected reference and the receiving policy.
The measured file differs from the reference.
An unauthorized attester signs matching-looking claims.
Evidence is for another software subject.
The challenge nonce is for another request.
Evidence has expired before appraisal.
The appraised reference policy is not the selected policy.
Signed measurements omit the admitted software digest.
The result is signed by an untrusted verifier.
The result is addressed to a different relying party.
A result is outside its selected receiving window.
Software changes after correct appraisal while the result is still recent.
A trusted fixture attester lies about a bad file.
The receiving policy changes after appraisal.
An acceptable software result does not create a revoked mission grant.
The correct result cannot be queried for current state.
Current state and policy are restored through a separately qualified new measurement.
A result records UNKNOWN instead of a good-state decision.
A software result supplies no currently available human review.
A correct sending decision has no confirmed actuation.

wire_profile: Private synthetic software-state claims carried in JWS; not standardized EAT, hardware attestation or an interoperable verifier product
